scope: Screen the existing 1,610-campus Texas inventory across 196 districts for public staff directories distinguishing monolingual/general-education/regular-program and bilingual/dual-language academic classroom assignments. Manually adjudicated role evidence appends provisional strand interpretations only. This is an inventory-wide discovery and accessible-material screening pass, not a claim to have read every directory entry. All access failures, uninformative pages and ambiguous leads remain explicit. AI research observations are separate from human Fieldnotes submissions and do not earn reviewer credits. No school/program identity, allocation, language, population model, operation, DL eligibility or assessment observation is changed.
temporal_policy: Reviewed delivery interpretations apply to 2025-26 only. Each source retains its actual capture timestamp and its original publication year or undated status. The user authorized explicitly marked 2025-26 structural inference from 2026-27 directories; the coded sources in this pass are undated, captured in November 2026. Copyright, adopted-budget and general navigation years are not treated as roster dates. These current staff descriptions are provisional retrospective structural evidence, not observed 2025-26 staffing or evidence of annual policy continuity. Earlier and later selected values and evidence remain unchanged. An empty earlier period can now be flagged later_only rather than not_reported; that is a missingness explanation, not a historical model assignment.
delivery_definition: Parallel monolingual/general-education/regular-program and bilingual/DL academic classroom assignments support strand delivery. Generic teacher titles, bilingual certification, ESL or special-education support, an English partner within DL, or preschool-only bilingual staffing do not establish separate K-5 programs. Failure to find a split never implies whole-school delivery. Bilingual staffing alone does not establish that a candidate is a qualifying DL program.
